2174-2645-3430-5621.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2645-5233-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Boros Garrison's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{W}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

2060-4687-4702.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least four counters on it.
2060-4687-4702.description:
Activate Splinter Twin by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least three mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Crystalline Crawler, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

4802-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat

345-728--5.easyPrerequisites: One of the persist creature's creature types is chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-728--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat

1286-5972-6495.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1286-5972-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1286-5972-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3257-3967-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

3532-5078-7356-7811.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent
Repeat.

2092-4954-5621.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has at least 7 power.
2092-4954-5621.description:
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding two mana.
Activate Silvanus's Invoker by paying {1}, untapping Arid Archway and causing it to become an 8/8 Elemental with trample and haste in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may tap and untap any other land(s) you control, and if you control lands that can produce {R} and {G}, use the mana to activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron's ability.

261-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

457-1458-3168-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-1458-3168-4404.description:
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Urza's Incubator.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

3668-4004-7149.description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Flesh Duplicate dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Turtle, gaining its abilities.
When Flesh Duplicate enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Flesh Duplicate leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Flesh Duplicate from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

252-1575-2981-5776.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra's second ability and Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Nuka-Cola Vending Machine trigger, creating a tapped Treasure token. The Treasure will enter as a 7/7 Dinosaur Food in addition to its types due to Displaced Dinosaurs and Ygra.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

3297-6291-7304.manaNeeded: {U} and {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable
3297-6291-7304.description:
Cast Genghis Frog either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable
When Genghis Frog enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Artificial Evolution by paying its mana cost, changing all instances of "Mutant" on Genghis Frog to "Thopter".
Resolve the Genghis Frog ability, creating a Mutagen token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
When the Thopter enters, Genghis Frog triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat step 5.
3297-6291-7304.notes: Step 5 creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

250-779-1479-4693-6662.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-4693-6662.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2279-5220-6705-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2279-5220-6705-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

856-2438-4321-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2438-4321-5632.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

3951-4050-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
3951-4050-4875-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat during each combat phase.

1742-4365-5742-5743.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart, adding {B}.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1778-2538-3676-5187.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Guardian Project triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Guardian Project trigger, causing you to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1170-2397-2733-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

333-2730-2921.notablePrerequisites: Kaya's Ghostform attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-2730-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2907-4826-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-4826-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and each Scute Swarm you control trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve a Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

2429-2557-3193.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Olivia deathtouch.
2429-2557-3193.description:
Give Olivia deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Olivia's first ability by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to a creature an opponent controls, destroying it due to Olivia's deathtouch, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Olivia.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you have a way to give Olivia deathtouch indefinitely, you may repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Boonweaver Giant

678-891-4050-4089-5214.notablePrerequisites: Next of Kin attached to Glasspool Mimic.
678-891-4050-4089-5214.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding one mana of any color.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, Enduring Renewal and Next of Kin trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Next of Kin trigger, putting Glasspool Mimic from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Boonweaver Giant.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Next of Kin from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Glasspool Mimic.
Repeat.

3563-4068-4803-5261.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {2}.
You control at least one Mountain.
3563-4068-4803-5261.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {2}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Flicker of Fate without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Flicker of Fate, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

3340-3542-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six lands.
3340-3542-4772.description:
Activate six lands by tapping them, creating twelve Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate eleven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Palinchron by paying {2}{U}{U}, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

2034-4980-5037-5220.notablePrerequisites: Anje does not have summoning sickness.
2034-4980-5037-5220.description:
Activate Anje by tapping it and discarding Blazing Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla is discarded into exile due to its madness ability.
Anje and Blazing Rootwalla trigger.
Resolve the Anje trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blazing Rootwalla trigger, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla, adding {C}{C}.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Blazing Rootwalla on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Anje ability from step 1, causing you to draw Blazing Rootwalla from the top of your library.
Repeat.

1550-1558-3719-5300.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to Akiri.
Akiri does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four artifacts.
An opponent cannot block Akiri.
1550-1558-3719-5300.description:
Deal combat damage using Akiri.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, causing you to exile Ruthless Technomancer, then search your library for a basic land card, and put it and Ruthless Technomancer onto the battlefield.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Akiri and create at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Akiri from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Sword of Hearth and Home's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Akiri.
Repeat each turn.

751-5115-5283.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least one charge counter on it.
751-5115-5283.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1475-2486-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You control an additional modified creature with power one or greater.
1475-2486-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding one mana of any color.
The creature dies, triggering One with the Kami, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Each Spirit enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat.

343-539-1247.notablePrerequisites: Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
343-539-1247.description:
Activate Pili-Pala by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
